summary: Issue #105 TDD implementation complete. All 8 steps implemented: (1) estimate_tokens changed from bytes/4 to chars/4 with min-1 guarantee, (2) tokens_to_char_budget helper added, (3) estimate_entry_meta_tokens for path/relation/score/heading/symbols, (4) estimate_entry_tokens combining meta+snippet, (5) truncate_snippet_for_char_budget with head60%+tail40% strategy and underflow protection, (6) build_context_pack refactored with unified truncation logic (continue instead of break, first-entry exception, snippet dynamic truncation, empty->None normalization, Ok.map pattern removed), (7) CLI help/validation updated (max-tokens 1..=1000000, max-files 1..=1000, CONTEXT_AFTER_HELP updated, help_llm.rs updated), (8) E2E tests added/modified (15 total context pack tests including value_parser validation, snippet truncation, metadata token counting). 20 new unit tests + 6 new E2E tests added.
